judge.rationale: The candidate never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block, meaning the bug remains unfixed and its own new acceptance test in `beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts` will fail. Additionally, the candidate completely missed the acceptance criterion requiring an update to `CHANGELOG.md`. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate replaced the bullet in place under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section (leaving the 'These three properties... out-of-scope' heading contradictory) rather than moving the new guarantee into the main requirements list as the reference did. Finally, the candidate left an untracked `.lore/dod.md` artifact and created a separate test file instead of adding the test to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
